Messages.Author: Jyhad_addict
Messages.Body:
I believe that most of the cards/rules need no clarification, but
because some ppl of my playgroup insist on some matters, i'd
appreciate a short answer to each of the following questions.(i state
what i believe, tell me if i am wrong)

1. You cannot play a 2nd mirror image to continue the same action

2. minion A bleeds, minion B says block, minion A plays supperior
faceless night, minion B does not block but has the chance to play
Telepathic Misdirection before tapping from supperior Faceless Night.
(that is because faceless night indicates that the minion taps when
the action is resolved, before resolving the action. Denying to block
any further doesn't mean that the action has resolved.)

3. can Rotschreck be played on me if i am immune to aggra damage ?
i believe the answer is yes, correct ?

4. Minion A bleeds, minion B wakes and plays telepathic misdirection,
minion C sends the bleed back, minion B blocks without having to play
a 2nd wake.

5. Can you play a forced awakening with a torporous vampire, just to
get rid of it ? (don't laugh, it has cost me a whole game not knowing
if i can, i think i can't but i am not sure)

6. can i play amaranth on a minion that plays ashes to ashes ? is he
sent to torpor ending combat ? or combat ends and then the minion goes
to torpor, like rotschreck ? i believe i can play amaranth.

7. Baltimore Purge triggers during my untap even if the vampire having
it is already in torpor.

8. I have a 5-cap vampire with 2 master disciplines on him making him
a 7-cap.
if he gets banished, while uncontrolled he is considered 5-cap
(because the 2 master disciplines are considered out of play) and he
just needs to have 5 blood to move to the ready region again.

9. can i prevent blood fury damage by spending ablative counters from
Ablative Skin ? i believe no.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On 6 Jun 2004 15:24:14 -0700, geo...@for.auth.gr (Jyhad_addict)
wrote:

>1. You cannot play a 2nd mirror image to continue the same action

False.

Mirror Image is only an action modifier when used for stealth.
You may use the combat ability as many times as it is required to get
the action thru and you have requisite blood.

LSJ 2002-11-05
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3DC7C991.8DF8A44A%40white-wolf.com

>2. minion A bleeds, minion B says block, minion A plays supperior
>faceless night, minion B does not block but has the chance to play
>Telepathic Misdirection before tapping from supperior Faceless Night.

True.

LSJ 2002-03-21
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3C9A6203.95F781E2%40white-wolf.com

>3. can Rotschreck be played on me if i am immune to aggra damage ?

Yes.

Section 3.5 of the FAQ
http://www.thelasombra.com/vtes_faq.htm

>4. Minion A bleeds, minion B wakes and plays telepathic misdirection,
>minion C sends the bleed back, minion B blocks without having to play
>a 2nd wake.

Correct.

Wake with Evening's Freshness and Forced Awakening last for the entire
action, by card text.

LSJ 2003-09-17
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3F68FD22.5080604%40white-wolf.com

>5. Can you play a forced awakening with a torporous vampire, just to
>get rid of it ? (don't laugh, it has cost me a whole game not knowing
>if i can, i think i can't but i am not sure)

No.

Reaction cards must be played by ready minions unless card text
specifically over-rides this rule.

1.6.3.5 Definition of Reaction Cards
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/

>6. can i play amaranth on a minion that plays ashes to ashes ?

Yes.

"goes to torpor"

LSJ 2001-12-14
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3C1A45C6.FEF4BC84%40white-wolf.com

>is he sent to torpor ending combat ?

At which point you play Amaranth, this is the exact same time that you
would play Amaranth in all situations that did not involve Ashes to
Ashes.

>7. Baltimore Purge triggers during my untap even if the vampire having
>it is already in torpor.

Correct.

Card text does not require the vampire to be anywhere aside from "in
play".

LSJ 2002-10-22
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3DB53907.FCDDA8A6%40white-wolf.com

>8. I have a 5-cap vampire with 2 master disciplines on him making him
>a 7-cap. if he gets banished, while uncontrolled he is considered 5-cap
>(because the 2 master disciplines are considered out of play) and he
>just needs to have 5 blood to move to the ready region again.

Correct.

LSJ 2001-05-30
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3B1573BB.2017225C%40white-wolf.com

>9. can i prevent blood fury damage by spending ablative counters from
>Ablative Skin ?

No.

LSJ 2002-10-30
